style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern community thank-you gathering. Residents stand around a humble elderly volunteer seated in center, enthusiastically singing and speaking praises directed toward him, one offers bouquet, others applaud. Behind him a board contains ONLY two large picture-only scenes of his good works: carrying food to an elderly neighbor and helping children repair a playground. No text on board or stage, no musical notes, no medals with letters. The central person smiles modestly, listeners gesturing toward pictures as they praise his contributions and kindness. Emphasize public praise of a named-by-image person's accomplishments and goodness, not generic concert celebration. Safe warm community setting, natural anatomy and five fingers, bouquet grip plausible, chair supported and grounded. Landscape 3:2, graphite watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper, no logos brands watermarks letters or numbers.
alt: 居民圍著年長志工獻花、歌唱與鼓掌，身後圖板畫出他送食物、修遊樂場的善行，大家讚揚他的付出。
